## OPERATOR DECISION (2026-08-24) — promote to epic; decompose into thin, independently-verifiable vertical slices

Promoting to an **epic**. Today there is NO MCP HTTP service on the box (rebar-mcp is stdio-only;
ADR 0050 explicitly DEFERS AWS recipes), autodeploy (ADR 0079) rebuilds review-bot only, and nginx
has no /mcp/ route. So the work splits into an ADR that settles exposure/auth/routing, an
approval-gated infra deploy, and safe local docs/config slices that can land under normal gates once
the endpoint + auth mode are decided. Slices below; each is independently verifiable. The AWS deploy
+ live verification remain approval-gated (human performs them).
